_guide: This file is the instance's parameter SSOT. Instantiation fills it from
the project's stated intent, then replaces parameter_status with
'filled'. While the ASL-PARAMETER-UNFILLED marker survives anywhere in
this file, `asl-loop state validate` errors and loop.sh refuses to run.
documents: the domain state files under state/, each with a `seed`
(initial content, written once by `asl-loop state ensure`) and a
`schema` (JSON Schema subset: type, enum, const, pattern, required,
properties, additionalProperties, items, minItems/maxItems,
minimum/maximum). `pattern` uses the same restricted glob dialect as
deny_patterns below (NOT a regex).
logs: extra append-only .jsonl files (runs.jsonl always exists).
policy: loop thresholds (positive integers).
protected_paths: target-relative paths/globs only a human may change —
the guard hook denies agent writes, and cycle commits exclude them
(a human resume checkpoint records them instead). fnmatch semantics.
deny_patterns: extra path patterns the guard hook denies to agent
writes. Restricted glob dialect — literal characters, `*` (any run,
including `/`), leading `^` (anchor to start), trailing `$` (anchor
to end); substring-search semantics, no escapes. NOT a regex — see
the recipe README's conversion table; validate warns on legacy-regex
lookalikes.
deny_bash_patterns: extra command patterns the guard hook denies
(same restricted glob dialect).
Delete this _guide array once the parameters are filled.
